spells.name: Arcane Missile
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick the closest visible enemy fighter within 15" of the caster to be the target. That fighter is hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Add 1 to the Damage value.

spells.name: Flaming Weapon
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 6" of the caster to be the target, then pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons to *ignited* until the end of the round. While a weapon is *ignited*:

- It gains the *Arcane* Weapon Trait.
- Improve its Rend characteristic by 1.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the spell from 6" to 12".

spells.name: Eldritch Barrier
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick 2 visible points on a platform or the battlefield floor, each within 9" of the caster, 6" of each other and the same elevation. A barrier is drawn between these two points.

The barrier remains in play until the end of the round or the caster is taken down. While the barrier is in play:

- Subtract 1 from attack rolls for ranged attacks made that cross the barrier.
- Fighters that are activated in the barrier or move across the barrier suffer d3 damage.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** The 2 points can be set up within 9" of each other instead of 6".

spells.name: Silence
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible enemy *Wizard* or *Priest* within 12" to be the target. Until the end of the round, that fighter cannot make arcane actions.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range from 12" to 18".

spells.name: Torrent of Fire
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Place the flame template. Each fighter in its area is targeted and hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3+1.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** The Rend value is -2.

spells.name: Umbral Vortex
spells.text:
**Casting Value [9+]**

Place the blast template centred on a visible point within 15" of the caster, it then scatters d6".

Each fighter in its area is hit with the following attack:

Rend -1, Damage d3+1.

After the attacks have been resolved, the blast template remains where it is. It represents a vortex that remains in play until the end of the round.

Line of sight cannot be drawn across the vortex for fighters on the same elevation. In addition, fighters who start their activation within the vortex, or move across it, are hit with the same attack.

At the end of the round, remove the vortex.

**Critical Cast [13+]:** It does not scatter.

spells.name: Healing Essence
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 15" of the caster to be the target. Heal d3 life points to the target.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Heal 3 life points instead of d3.

spells.name: Bless Thy Blade
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 9" of the caster to have *blessed blades* until the end of the round. While a fighter has *blessed blades*, add 1 to hit rolls for melee attacks made by them.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** If critically cast, up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked instead of 1.

spells.name: Godspeed
spells.text:
**Casting Value [6+]**

Until the end of the round, the caster has a 9" aura of *godspeed*. Friendly fighters who begin a move while they are within the aura add 1" to the maximum distance they can move.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the aura from 9" to 12".

spells.name: Will of The Saints
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Pick a visible friendly fighter within 15" of the caster. That fighter has the *Will of the Saints* until the end of the round. While a fighter has the *Will of the Saints*, *improve* their Armour value by 1, to a maximum of 2+. (For example, 6+ becomes 5+).

**Critical Cast [10+]:** If critically cast, up to 2 friendly fighters can be picked instead of 1.

spells.name: Holy Strength
spells.text:
**Casting Value [7+]**

Until the end of the round, the caster has a 6" aura of *holy strength*. Add 1 to the Critical Damage values of melee weapons used by friendly fighters while they are within the aura.

**Critical Cast [10+]:** Increase the range of the aura from 6" to 9".

spells.name: Consecrated Ground
spells.text:
**Casting Value [8+]**

Pick a visible point on the battlefield floor within 12" of the caster. While a friendly fighter is within 3" of that point, their armour value is improved by 1.

The spell remains in play. While this spell is in play, the caster must pass a Willpower test at the start of their activation, else the spell ends. If they attempt to cast this spell again while it is still in play, the first instance of it ends (even if they fail to cast it again).

If the caster is taken down, the spell ends.

**Critical Cast [12+]:** While the spell is in play, friendly fighters are affected while they are within 6" of that point, instead of 3".
